text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet injures herself during
training, so I
rush her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Sorry about all the trouble...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine now, though. I can't waste the
day lying
down like this.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Especially if I'm going to be number one!
I have to
get back and train even harder!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Especially if I'm going to be number one!
I have to
get back and train even harder!

choice_data_list_en: ...Let's get you properly healed so you can become number one.
With that attitude, you'll heal in no time!
With that kind of spirit, you'll heal in no time!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I don't need your advice. I'm the patient
here,
and I say I'm fine!

choice_data_list_en: If you can't give it your all, there's no point in practicing.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. There's no point in
running when I
can't even stand upright.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Sigh... What am I doing?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To be on the safe side, today's training

assignment is for Daiwa Scarlet to rest
up.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hehe, exactly! I knew you'd get it!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: All right, let's get back to it!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Don't be so wishy-washy. I've got to
push myself
if I want to be number one,
don't I?
choice_data_list: それはさすがに無茶だ！
それはさすがに無茶だよ！

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's g―

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Argh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She tries to force her way back into
training but
ends up collapsing. In the
end, it takes several
days for her to
properly recover.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well, if we're in agreement, then let's
focus on
getting me healed up.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I suppose we should start with applying
an ice...
pack...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Why are you looking at me like that?
Was that
really such a weird thing to
say?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I want to get back to training as soon as
I can. If
I'm going to be number one, I
can't neglect my
health.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. You should be! What else would
you
expect from me?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You're talking to the future number one

Umamusume, after all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shortly after, Daiwa Scarlet returns to
training
without incident.
